{{Quote|Back to your cockpit, little girl.|An Elite stormtrooper, to his commanding officer|<ref name="SW13" />}}
'''Elite stormtroopers''' were a class of special forces [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|stormtroopers]] founded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Darth Vader formed a special detachment of six such [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] vengeance campaign two months after the Battle of Yavin. These elite troopers acted as executors of Vader's wrath against those who betrayed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="SW13" />

==History==
===Establishment by Vader's hand===
{{Quote|Despite outside appearances, there is a complex and varied hierarchy within the stormtrooper ranks. I thought I understood it all. But to even access the dossiers on this team, I had to be cleared for a security level far above my rank.|Ensign Nanda|<ref name="SW13" />}}
[[File:EliteTroopersPrepare-SW2013-13.png|thumb|left|300px|The Elite stormtroopers ship out on their mission]]
In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kell Bircher]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] planted deep in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ranks, coordinated the embarrassing [[Attack on the Rebel Fleet|defeat]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator/Legends|Devastator]],'' [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] former [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. As punishment for the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] diverted Vader to oversee the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Intent on getting revenge, Vader abandoned his assigned posting to initiate a campaign of vengeance against those responsible for Bircher's infiltration. Vader assigned [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] [[Nanda (ensign)|Nanda]] as his personal assistant and created a special detachment of Elite stormtroopers for this unsanctioned mission. The Elite stormtroopers and the missions they participated in would never appear on any official Imperial records as their operation was against the wishes of the Emperor. They [[Mission to Coruscant (Darth Vader)|departed]] Vader's new flagship ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]'' for the [[Data Center|Imperial data center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]].<ref name="SW13" />

===Commanded by Vader's hand===
[[File:Vadersquad-SW2013-13.png|thumb|right|300px|Darth Vader and Nanda, flanked by their elite stormtrooper escort]]
Arriving on Imperial Center, the Elite stormtroopers accompanied Vader as he interrogated the [[Major/Legends|major]] in charge on how a false history of Bircher's entire life and military service could have been sliced into Imperial [[Datacore/Legends|data cores]]. Vader tasked the troopers with locating and executing the [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]], ordering his second-in-command to pull all personnel files, and to further interrogate the major to set an example.<ref name="SW13" />

Vader upgraded the team's transport to the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] ''[[Archer (Assassin-class)|Archer]]'' for a long [[Hyperspace/Legends|jump]] to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. After he transmitted a code to lower the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan's]] [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary defenses]], the ''Archer'' parked in low orbit. The Elite stormtroopers were divided into two teams of three to neutralize suspected Bothan [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], while the ''Archer'' used a [[Warhead/Legends|warhead launcher]] to destroy designated targets. The troopers [[Mission to Bothawui (Darth Vader)|conducted]] home invasions, up-close murders, collective punishment, and committed arson to clean up. Next they [[Mission to Kuat (Darth Vader)|accompanied]] Vader to [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] where he punished the command staff of the ''Devastator'' for taking orders from Colonel Bircher.<ref name="SW13" /> 

===Dissolution by Vader's hand===
When Nanda received an intelligence report claiming a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] spotted a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] rendezvous and old star destroyed amid the remnants of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Vader [[Mission to Alderaan (Darth Vader)|ordered]] her to make for the [[Alderaan system/Legends|system]]. The ex-Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Tag Rogaren]] felt responsible for the destruction of Alderaan and had left the Empire to live on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class star destroyer]] ''[[Audacity]]'' in the [[The Graveyard|Graveyard]]. Shortly after the team entered the system, a [[Bounty/Legends|kill-or-capture order]] was issued for Rogaren over the Imperial [[HoloNet/Legends|MilNet]]. This order was a good paying contract on an easy target, and would likely attract [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], military contractors, professional [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], off-duty Imperials, and active-duty troopers, like the Elite stormtroopers, who had heard the order over their own comm gear.<ref name="SW14" />

After the troopers captured Rogaren, Vader ordered them to leave him alone with the prisoner. The troopers refused and pulled their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] on Vader, claiming a MilNet order superseded his off-the-books mission. They sought to return the high-value target to Imperial Center for compensation and attempted to get Vader to stand down. Vader proceeded to [[Sai tok/Legends|cut]], [[Glove of Darth Vader|crush]], and [[Telekinesis/Legends|suffocate]] all of the Elite stormtroopers.<ref name="SW14" />

==Organization==
{{Quote|Special detachment reporting as ordered, Lord Vader.|Ensign Nanda|<ref name="SW13" />}}
[[File:EliteVaderSquad.png|thumb|left|400px|The six elite stormtroopers operated directly under Darth Vader.]]
The Elite stormtroopers were specially created for a special detachment consisting of six troopers. Information on these troopers was so classified, they essentially did not exist in official Imperial records. While they were led by an ensign officer, they took orders directly from Darth Vader.<ref name="SW13" /> The stormtroopers ultimately decided, however, that MilNet orders superseded the off-the-books commands given by Vader, who responded by executing the entire stormtrooper detachment.<ref name="SW14" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|He was looking at the actual contents of our shuttle, and realizing it was enough armament for a pretty respectable planetary invasion. Along with six Elite stormtroopers that didn't exist.|Ensign Nanda|<ref name="SW13" />}}
[[File:ThreeEliteStormtroopers-SW2013-13.png|thumb|right|300px|Elite stormtroopers in their standard, if marked, gear.]]
Elite stormtroopers wore standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]]. They wore black masks under their helmets that left only their eyes and mouth unobscured. A dark grey circle with a black circle in the middle was painted on their helmet and chestplate. They were equipped with a black [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]], black utility belt, and a [[SD-48 survival backpack/Legends|survival pack]]. They typically carried heavier blasters like [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifles]] and [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blasters]], but they also wielded [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifles]], and [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifles]] depending on the mission.<ref name="SW13" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's told through the eyes of a young ensign who is assigned as Vader's aide as he brutalizes his way across the galaxy. I got to invent a new class of Special Forces Stormtrooper as well. It's one of those stories that made me grin while I wrote it, and I love it to pieces.|Brian Wood, about the ''Five Days of Sith'' mini-arc|<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/wood-brings-a-fresh-take-on-the-familiar-in-star-wars|text=Wood Brings A Fresh Take on the Familiar In "Star Wars"|author=Steve Sunu|date=2013-09-16|archivedate=20210126112401}}</ref>}}
The Elite stormtrooper first appeared in the [[Star Wars (2013) 13|thirteenth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars (2013)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[Brian Wood]] and pencilled by [[Facundo Percio]]. Released on [[January 8]], [[2014]], it is the first of a two-part arc, [[Star Wars: Five Days of Sith|''Five Days of Sith'']].<ref name="SW13" />
